It is a drawing in an SOE file, not a photograph, so the pre-1957 photo rule does not apply; and an unpublished Crown work of that age may still be in Crown copyright (to 2039). Either way the OGL v3.0 licence covers reuse with attribution, so it is rights-clear: credited on screen as 'The National Archives, HS 7/49 · OGL v3.0'.
